title: Wind Chimes, No Wind

lyrics:
[Intro: one chime, then silence, then two]

[Layer 1: kalimba pattern begins]

[Layer 2: glass bells added, a different rhythm]

[Layer 3: metal chimes, the patterns interlock]

[Drop: deep bass and shuffling beat lift everything]

[Break: beat stops, chimes alone, slower]

[Drop: full groove returns, a marimba line on top]

[Outro: layers leave one by one, last chime, air]
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 126 BPM, 4/4 with a shuffle, C minor. Hypnotic and gently propulsive, bright sounds over a dark floor.

VOICE: None.

INSTRUMENTS: Kalimba (thumb piano), glass bells, metal wind chimes and a glockenspiel in interlocking patterns, a deep, warm sub bass, a shuffling beat with a soft kick and brushed snare, a marimba, hand percussion, a faint pad.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, single chimes. 0:16 Layer 1, kalimba. 0:36 Layer 2, bells. 0:56 Layer 3, chimes. 1:16 Drop, bass and beat. 1:56 Break. 2:14 Drop, with marimba. 2:50 Outro, layers leaving, ends 3:18.

PRODUCTION & MIX: Early-2010s organic downtempo: dry, close, detailed percussion with a large, soft low end.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: The bass arriving under the chimes at 1:16.

STATION FIT: Sunday, 4 a.m. The stillest hour, with nothing but small bright sounds and a pulse.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Curious, gathering, lifted, dispersing.
